pull.title: refactor: Enable more tidy bugprone checks
pull.body:
Enable some bugprone clang-tidy checks, which seem useful.

Apart from a test-only bug, they didn't find anything severe, but I think it still makes sense to enable them, so that it is easier to read the resulting code. Also, it is trivial to disable them, if they turn out annoying.
